notes: Brand-applicability caveat ships with the file: the page states the styles documented here are the Fedders-Airwell styles and that, although unconfirmed, it is believed all Fedders-Airwell units use these styles. Only Building Center Style 2 ships, year-only. Building Center Style 1 is HELD despite its text-stated week/year positions because its shape (2 letters + 9 digits + letter, 12 characters) is identical to held Style 3's shape, so a matching serial could be either system (shape-collision hold). Styles 3, 4 and 5 are HELD entirely: their year and month are both chart letters with no text table.

styles.era: 8-character serials, 2 digits + letter + 5 digits (Building Center Style 2)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-based: year = 1st & 2nd characters, month = 3rd character (letter chart image FEDDERS-2-Serial-Number.jpg only, held), so this style ships year-only. Page example shown as '02J-60002'; normalized form used here. Year value derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.
